title: TOYO Co., Ltd Announces Unaudited and Unreviewed First Quarter 2026 Financial Results and Reaffirms Guidance
summary: TOYO Co., Ltd (Nasdaq: TOYO) (OTC: TOYWF), ("TOYO" or the "Company"), a solar solution company, today announced its unaudited and unreviewed financial results for the first quarter ended March 31, 2026, and reaffirmed its 2026 guidance. First Quarter 2026 Highlights Revenues of $142.8 million, an increase of 177.0% year-over-year Net income of $28.4 million, compared to a net loss of $3.7 million in Q1 2025 EBITDA (Non-GAAP) of $48.1 million, compared to EBITDA of $2.4 million in Q1 2025 Adjusted EBITDA (Non-GAAP) of $48.3 million, compared to adjusted EBITDA $2.8 million in Q1 2025 Net income per diluted share of $0.75, compared to net loss per diluted share of $0.10 in Q1 2025 "We delivered a powerful start to 2026, achieving strong first-quarter revenue and net income growth that reflects the successful scale-up of our advanced manufacturing capabilities," said Takahiko Onozuka, Chairman and CEO of TOYO.
